new_policy: Prepare and retain CPU face models before first live frame.
Publish completed information immediately in source order; discard superseded late information.
Cancel information HTTP after min(configured_timeout, 5s); no retry.
Independent lane admission, same evidence when both have capacity, skip busy lanes without queuing old windows.
limitations: One live validation run; provider timing varies between runs.
Grounding retains its own configured timeout and ordered publication.
Dropping superseded or timed-out observations can lose a brief event seen only in that window.
Timeout is HTTP wall time, not a five-second end-to-end delivery guarantee.
